story_title: OpenAI and AARP Launch AI Training Across 10 U.S. Cities
caption:
OpenAI and AARP are partnering to bring free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to 1,000 older adults across 10 U.S. cities. The program focuses on teaching everyday AI skills while emphasizing safety and digital confidence.

As artificial intelligence becomes embedded in daily infrastructure, bridging the adoption gap across all age groups is fast becoming a priority.

Do you think guided workshops are the best way to make tech accessible?
